correctness.rationale: For the specified LCF=[−12,7,−7]^8 simple cubic 24-vertex graph, the update rule is an exact 24-bit map using each of the three open neighbors and threshold two; the state domain has exactly 2^24=16,777,216 masks. The frozen C++ source constructs all successors, traces each functional-graph component to a recurrent cycle, and back-propagates first-entry depths. An independently written new C++ traversal (not a replay of saved logs) classified all 16,777,216 states: 550 fixed configurations, 63,715 primitive two-cycles, the listed 12-entry table and consensus basins 1,033,256 each. It confirmed F^13=F^11 for every state, and F^12≠F^10 at witness 152253, so 11 is sharp. Separate NetworkX group enumeration found exactly 32 automorphisms; applying all permutations to recurrent masks and identifying phase-exchanged two-cycle orbits yielded 39 and 2,415 spatial classes. Exhaustive finite proof is appropriate because the theorem explicitly concerns only this one finite state space; it is not an infinite-family extrapolation.
